142:t_010:3.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I never imagined that even the $$地球連邦軍$$ had surrendered to the Empire...」

142:t_010:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Only some of them. The $$地球連邦$$ itself has not surrendered to the Empire.」

142:t_010:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We failed to destroy $$クロノ$$ completely, so its power still influences the Federation troops.」

142:t_010:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then the people we fought today were...」

142:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They were probably under $$クロノ$$'s influence. They also collaborated with $$ジェミニス$$, after all.」

142:t_010:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「But we defeated the Empire's pawns...! The Miracle of $$厳島$$ is still alive!」

142:t_010:9.en:
$$五飛$$
「But the Empire's main force remains intact... ...Perhaps they merely made us play a part in their plan...」

142:t_010:11.en:
$$五飛$$
「For the Empire, making Earthlings fight each other here was probably the whole point of the operation.」

142:t_010:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...This battle... Will it have grave implications for $$新日本$$...?」

142:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! Do you think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has a future after joining forces with $$サイデリアル$$?!」

142:t_011:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I don't need you to tell me that!」

142:t_011:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then come with us! You fought alongside us once. You should know what you ought to do!」

142:t_011:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sure Colonel $$シャア$$ wants that too!」

142:t_011:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass that man...! And with that power, the $$スペースノイド$$s...!」

142:t_011:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of my way, $$カミーユ$$! You and $$アムロ・レイ$$ are both my enemies!」

142:t_012:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it...! Is this as far as I go?!」

142:t_012:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$ギュネイ$$! I want to talk to you!」

142:t_012:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have nothing to say to you! I am... $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

142:t_013:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So our words can't reach him...」

142:t_013:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's such a stubborn fool...」

142:t_014:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「We're coordinating well. We can do this.」

142:t_014:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This isn't some Miracle of $$厳島$$. It's our own skill!」

142:t_100:0.en:
$$五飛$$
($$ナタク$$... Somewhere in my heart, I was probably looking for a place to die...)

142:t_100:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「But not anymore...! Until peace returns to the world, I'll devote this life to fighting!」

142:t_100:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「That is the meaning of my life... of my battles...! That is justice!」

142:t_101:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me if you dare! I'm not planning to pull off any miracles!」

142:t_101:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Your losing to me is only natural! I'll teach you that in your bones!」

142:t_102:1.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「What's wrong, $$ロジャー$$? The enemy is right in front of us.」

142:t_102:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No... The true enemy must be much farther away. Something inside me is telling me so.」

142:t_102:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I don't know. But to restore peace to the world, we will probably need to negotiate with that being.」

142:t_102:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Until we get there, I will fight alongside $$ビッグオー$$!」

142:t_103:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$フィアナ$$... Even in this world where I've lost you, I will keep fighting...)

142:t_103:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(For your wish... for a world without war.)

142:t_104:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$! I'll defeat you and prove my power!」

142:t_104:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass both the Colonel and $$フル・フロンタル$$ for $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s future!」

142:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$シャア$$ is still within you after all!」

142:t_104:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$ギュネイ$$! You'll never surpass him while you keep chasing his shadow!」

142:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! I don't want to fight you!」

142:t_105:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't bring your pretend friendship onto the battlefield! You're part of the Federation, so you're my enemy!」

142:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Damn...! Do I have no choice but to fight?!」

142:t_106:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come on, $$カミーユ$$! I'll acquire power for $$ジオン$$'s future!」

142:t_106:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You stubborn fool...! Don't think you can change the world that way!」

142:t_106:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you want power, I'll take you on! And I'll show you how pointless that approach is!」

142:t_106:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Think about what the world needs now, $$ギュネイ$$!」

142:t_107:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Come with us and bring the $$ユニコーン$$!」

142:t_107:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If $$ラプラスの箱$$ can change the world, I'll use it for the future of the $$スペースノイド$$s... of $$ジオン$$!」

142:t_107:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「We need that power to lead $$ジオン$$'s future in the right direction!」

142:t_107:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's wrong! Only people's power can change the world!」

142:t_107:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever the Box really is, I won't accept trying to change the world with something like that!」

142:t_108:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! The friendly units aren't answering our cease-fire calls!」

142:t_108:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「They're former friendly units! I won't let those who caved in to $$サイデリアル$$ call themselves the $$地球連邦軍$$!」

142:t_108:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll return fire! We'll clean up our own side's mess ourselves!」

142:t_109:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This is bad... I thought the battle at $$厳島$$ was simply a plan to rob the Japanese people of their pride, but it may mean more than that...)

142:t_109:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This enemy is beyond comparison with $$ギルター$$... If we make a mistake, $$新日本$$ will...)

142:t_110:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Why...?! Why do Earthlings have to fight each other at a time like this?!」

142:t_110:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is this country that much of an obstacle to you?! Answer me!!」

142:t_111:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(The war with $$サイデリアル$$ is about to reignite conflict between Earth and the colonies too...)

142:t_111:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... Please guide the world...)

142:t_112:0.en:
$n
「I'll crush everyone who comes at us...!」

142:t_112:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the Federation are fellow Earthlings! This is no time for Earthlings to fight each other...」

142:t_112:2.en:
$n
「That's exactly why! That's why we can't afford to lose!」

142:t_112:3.en:
$n
「If we lose, this situation will surely spiral out of control...! Then Earth really will be finished!」
